summary: Father Andrew Stephen Damig explains that giving generously first causes one's heart to change, leading to feelings of generosity rather than selflessness. He suggests that Orthodox Christians should give more than the traditional 10% tithe under the New Covenant, urging listeners to take this step of faith to experience spiritual release. The segment concludes with Damig identifying himself as a priest at the Antiochian Orthodox Christian Archdiocese of North America in Emmaus, Pennsylvania.
